scope: TI parallel load-sharing core with two RGT amplifiers, independent feedback and 2.49-ohm output resistors; identical 25-to-50-ohm inductor-first filters to the single-RGT comparison

conditions.simulator: ngspice 45.2, native XSPICE code models, PSpice compatibility

limitations: Nominal electrical model, not a measured board or device/process/temperature corner.
Each spot frequency has a separately synthesized filter; this is not a single fixed broadband matching network or a verified practical relay/filter bank.

The all-sign tolerance check covers output L/C values at the operating fundamental only; selected extreme corners are replayed as complete transients. Input-filter tolerances, SRF spread, inductor saturation and PCB parasitics are not qualified.
TI linear-swing envelope and cooling must apply to the actual assembly. No electrothermal feedback or supply converter model.

The datasheet lists +/-100 mA continuous output current for electromigration; application of that rating to bipolar RF waveforms is not resolved here and the +/-420 mA linear-drive figure is not a lifetime guarantee.
The RGT macro-model FB-to-OUT path is 1 microohm; real package trace resistance and inductance are incompletely modeled.
Logic-stage rail estimates omit internal switching/crossover power; selected detector semiconductor models are illustrative.
Nominal matched models do not establish real device gain or phase matching; opposing DC offsets are one explicit current-sharing sensitivity.
Mutual thermal coupling and the actual two-chip layout are not simulated; thermal calculations are sensitivities.
No output-power regulation or mismatch protection is implemented.
